thesis: AI-native software for insurance carriers: underwriting, claims, and risk assessment. US-headquartered private companies.
inclusion_criteria: Software vendor (not the insurer/carrier itself, not a broker/agency, not a consultancy or TPA-only service)
Product is AI-native and centers on underwriting, claims processing, or risk assessment for insurance carriers/MGAs/reinsurers
Primary target customer is insurance carriers (or MGAs/reinsurers/TPAs acting on their behalf), not solely brokers/agencies or consumers
Private company (not publicly traded, not a subsidiary of a public company, not defunct/wound down)
